name: Model Switcher
description: Self-referencing LLM swap. Registers three agent tools (switch_model, current_model, list_model_tiers) so the agent can change its own active language model mid-turn, plus a /setmodel slash command that bypasses the LLM so the operator can recover when generation is broken from the start (e.g. missing/invalid provider key). Accepts explicit provider/model refs or a light/medium/heavy tier shortcut per foundation provider (anthropic, openai, google). Writes through api.runtime.config.replaceConfigFile with afterWrite.mode=auto so the gateway hot-reloads on the next turn.

allowedProviders.description: Optional allow-list of provider prefixes (e.g. ["anthropic", "openai", "gemini", "ollama"]). Empty/unset means no restriction beyond the <provider>/<model> shape check.
